artworks.title: Plate Number 499. Raking and packing hay
artworks.description: The image shows a sequence of photographs of a nude woman interacting with a bundle of hay using a stick. The woman is shown in different positions in each frame, with her face visible in some instances. The background features a gridded surface and a dark curtain.

artworks.title: Plate Number 213. Lifting and emptying basket
artworks.description: This is a photograph showing a series of black and white frames capturing the movement of a person with a basket. The frames document the stages of picking up, carrying, and emptying the basket. The setting is outdoors with a simple backdrop, focusing on the subject's physical movement and posture. The sequential imagery emphasizes the study of motion in a clear and scientific manner.

artworks.title: Plate Number 219. Stooping, and lifting broom and sweeping
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a series of images capturing a figure sweeping with a broom. The images depict the figure in different stages of movement while performing the sweeping action. They are organized in a grid format with a monochromatic tone.

artworks.title: Plate Number 220. Stooping, and lifting handkerchief and turning
artworks.description: The image shows a sequence of photographs displaying a nude individual in motion. The top row shows the person crouching down and standing up, while the bottom row captures similar movements from different angles. The individual has short hair tied closely to the head and is holding a small cloth or towel in some frames. The background consists of a tiled wall with horizontal lines, and the ground appears flat, resembling a paved or sports court.

artworks.title: Plate Number 245. Two models, turning around, sitting on the ground
artworks.description: The image is a series showing two women in dynamic poses. The subjects are standing, walking, interacting, and occasionally seated on the ground. Both women have long hair covering parts of their faces and shoulders. They are not wearing any clothing. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background includes a textured brick wall and a woven mat on the ground.

artworks.title: Plate Number 408. Two models, 1 pouring bucket of water over 8
artworks.creditLine: Edward E. MacCrone Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a sequence of black and white photographs featuring two nude individuals engaging in a playful water interaction. In each frame, one person is seated in a low bathtub, while the other stands nearby pouring water on them, creating splashes. Both individuals have short hair, and their facial features are visible in some frames. There is a fence or wall backdrop, suggesting an outdoor space.

artworks.title: Plate Number 430. Toilet; taking off clothes
artworks.description: This is a photograph showing a series of sequential motion studies of a person removing a piece of fabric. The grid layout contains two parallel rows of images capturing the progression of the action. The background appears to be a studio setting with simple, possibly textured or striped walls. The scenes are in black and white.

artworks.title: Plate Number 449. Feeding a dog
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a sequence featuring a dog interacting with another figure. The image consists of a grid of twelve smaller images, each capturing a progressive moment in the interaction between the two figures and the dog. The images seem to depict a motion study, with the background featuring a lined grid. The dog has a spotted coat, and the lighting is uniform, casting shadows on the ground, emphasizing the motion in each step and gesture. The sequence format suggests a study of movement and interaction.

artworks.title: Plate Number 501. Miscellaneous,—stooping, kneeling, etc.
artworks.description: The image features a series of black and white photographs showing a woman in various stages of a bathing motion sequence. She is holding a water jug and a towel, demonstrating washing or pouring water over herself. The woman's hair is tied back, and her facial expression is neutral as she moves through different postures. The photographs are laid out in two rows and show her standing, bending, and kneeling. The woman is nude and positioned on a wooden platform with a wire grid background behind her.

artworks.title: Plate Number 531. Various poses
artworks.description: The image features a sequence of frames showing a nude woman in various full-length poses from the front, back, and side. The woman's arms are positioned differently in each frame, and her facial features are not detailed. Her hair is styled in an updo or pulled back, and she is not wearing any clothing or jewelry or holding any objects. The background shows a grid pattern and the frames are arranged on a dark backdrop.

artworks.title: Plate Number 661. Mule; A, B, a refractory animal, Ruth
artworks.description: This is a series of frames showing the movement of a horse and rider. The frames are laid out in a grid format and document different moments in time of the horse in motion, including jumping, trotting, and bucking. The background is plain, emphasizing the study of the horse's motion.

artworks.title: Plate Number 710. Dog; galloping; white racing hound, Maggie
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a sequence capturing the motion of a running dog. The image is a series of black and white frames arranged in a grid format, documenting the gait and movement of the dog in detail. The dog is shown in profile in the top row, moving from left to right through each frame. In the bottom row, the dog is captured from the back, showing the movement of its legs and tail. The photographic sequences resemble early motion studies by Eadweard Muybridge, exploring locomotion.

artworks.title: Campo Vaccino, Rome
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Lynne and Joseph Horning
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of an ancient architectural scene. A large historical building dominates the center of the image, along with smaller historical structures surrounding it. In front of the building, there are ancient columns and a triumphal arch. Nearby, there is an open space with trees and carts. The image is in monochrome with sepia and brown tones, highlighting the textures of the structures.

artworks.title: Coastal Seascape
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Christopher and Beverly With in memory of Karl and Gerda With
artworks.description: This image shows a lakeside or riverside landscape with water, trees, and sailboats. A twisting tree with green foliage is in the foreground, alongside shrubs, grass, and rocks. The water reflects the sky and trees are visible in the distance with green and orange hues. The brushstrokes are soft and impressionistic. The color palette includes blues, greens, and browns.

artworks.title: Crying Girl
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Christopher and Beverly With in memory of Karl and Gerda With
artworks.description: The image shows an artwork of a person standing against a plain backdrop. The person is facing slightly to the side with hands near their face. Facial features are not distinct due to the hand placement. The individual has short or slicked-back hair, wearing loose-fitting clothing above mid-thigh and knee-length dark socks. The backdrop has textured vertical lines. The image is monochromatic in shades of black and gray.

artworks.title: Arcadian Landscape
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with two figures interacting with animals. One figure, a woman in a red skirt and white blouse, sits sideways on a donkey adorned with colorful fabrics and bells. The donkey carries a wooden crate. The other figure, an elegantly dressed man with a wide-brimmed hat, stands near a brown cow next to him, with some sheep nearby. They are by a classical ruin with tall columns and sculpted busts. In the background, there are trees and hints of architecture. The brushstrokes are loose and fluid, and the color palette is soft and earthy with shades of blue and green.

artworks.title: America
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper, incised for transfer

artworks.title: Lake with Swans
artworks.medium: color etching inked à la poupée on chine collé on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira  Jackson Collection
artworks.description: The image features a low angle view close to the water's edge with swans floating gracefully. The horizon is positioned high in the image, just below the upper quarter, with a distant tree line separating the sky and land. The brushstrokes are expressive and loose, giving the image a soft, textured appearance. The color palette includes earth tones like browns and greens contrasting against the white swans. Cattails and grasses frame the swans in the foreground. In the background, a figure in a boat and a statue stand out against foliage.

artworks.title: Virgin Adoring the Child
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated with her hands together in front of her. She appears to be looking downward at the infant in front of her. She has delicate facial features and wears a head covering. The infant is lying on a cloth surface, with its right hand slightly raised. There is a faint halo above the woman's head. The background shows a dark, indistinct setting with a wooden structure and a thatched roof.

artworks.title: Arms of the Bishopric of Eichstätt and of Its Bishop, Wilhelm of Reichenau
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a heraldic emblem. The artwork showcases a design of a coat of arms within a circular border, featuring scrollwork and Latin inscriptions. The emblem includes two helmets with plumes, a mitre, shield designs with various heraldic symbols, and angelic figures holding the shields. Latin text on the outer ring references "WILHELMVS EPISCOPVS EYSTETENSIS" and other phrases related to the origins or familial references in heraldry. The composition is symmetrical and detailed, reflecting traditional craftsmanship in European heraldic illustrations.

artworks.title: The Little Cavalier (Le Petit Cavalier)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rural scene with various animals and a rustic shelter. The scene features a group of animals including a donkey and several goats in the foreground, a dog near a basket of eggs, and a chicken with its chicks in the center. A thatched shelter, sheaves of wheat, a large tree with sprawling branches, and a wooden fence can also be seen. The sketch creates a lively, textured environment with intricate details of trees and structures, evoking a pastoral charm.

artworks.title: Mountainous Landscape with a Brook
artworks.artist: Joseph Hubert Blees, after Johann Bernard Klombeck
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a path running along a stream where a person walks with two donkeys. The scene includes detailed trees, forested hills in the distance, a silhouette of a possible ruined castle on a hill, cloudy skies, and a grayscale color palette reminiscent of a black and white etching.

artworks.title: Vesuvausbruch von 1771 (The Eruption of Mount Vesuvius in 1771)
artworks.artist: Johann Carl Richter, after Pierre-Jacques Volaire
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown, laid down on a mount with a contemporary printed ornamental border on blue paper and collaged title
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a volcanic eruption, likely Mount Vesuvius, viewed from an elevated vantage point overlooking a rugged landscape. There are silhouetted figures observing the scene from rocky outcroppings surrounded by foliage. Dense plumes of volcanic smoke fill the sky, contrasting with the dark mountain. The painting shows a meticulous technique in brushstrokes and shading to depict depth and texture, portraying movement and chaos in the smoke and lava flows. The color palette is sepia, creating a vintage and intense atmosphere. The image is bordered by decorative leafy motifs.

artworks.title: Catherine prépare le tub et Louise nue se coiffe (Catherine Prepares the Bath and Louise, Nude, Fixes her Hair)
artworks.medium: soft ground etching and drypoint [proof] on buff laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body view of a nude woman seated on a draped surface, with her legs slightly apart. She has her hands raised and touching her dark, styled or gathered hair. Her facial features are finely drawn, with eyes cast downward. To her side, another figure is crouched down, focusing on an object resembling a bowl. The background is plain, with a textured, sketch-like quality. The image focuses on the human form and posture with simple lines and shading.
